{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/examples/simple_with_custom.py:15:config-class"], "search": "    input_file: str = Field(..., cli=("-i", "--input"))
    max_records: int = Field(10, cli=("-m", "--max-records"))
    min_filter_score: float = Field(..., cli=("-f", "--filter-score"))", "replace": "    input_file: str = Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-i", "--input")})
    max_records: int = Field(10, json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-m", "--max-records")})
    min_filter_score: float = Field(..., json_schema_extra={"cli": ("-f", "--filter-score")})", "explanation": "Pydantic V2 deprecates passing arbitrary keyword arguments to Field() (the 'cli' keys raise PydanticDeprecatedSince20). Per the V2 migration guide, extra metadata must be supplied via json_schema_extra. The 'cli' values are moved unchanged into json_schema_extra so the same metadata is exposed. The three fields with cli= are the only ones that need this; alpha and values have no extra kwargs. The earlier model_config migration is kept as is."}], "notes": "The collection failure comes from the three Field(...) calls in Options that pass cli=... as extra keyword arguments (input_file, max_records, min_filter_score). Each one now passes the same tuple through json_schema_extra={"cli": ...}, which is the V2 replacement. The class Config to model_config = ConfigDict(...) migration from the earlier attempt is left intact. This is a single edit covering the three consecutive lines, so nothing overlaps. I did not touch alpha, values, the example_runner, or the __main__ block because none of them use deprecated APIs. Caveat: pydantic_cli/core.py must read the cli value from field_info.json_schema_extra (not the V1 field_info.extra) for the CLI behavior to remain identical; that file is migrated separately and was not in this file's scope. The model_config comprehension over DefaultConfig/ExampleConfigDefaults keys is assumed to only contain V2-valid keys since those base classes are outside this file."}
